plan_sections.SI-00: Architecture: the self-improvement agent is a scheduled composition of engineering memory (audit substrate), delta-to-run (planning pipeline), and convergence (outer loop). Mining/clustering live in observability (core-only imports); every plangraph join and dispatch lives in graphrun/improvement_program.py. Two pre-existing human gates: proposal ruling and per-round plan-approval receipt. Committed artifacts under docs/improvement/; mining state, drafts, and campaign ledgers gitignored under logs/improvement/. Engineering-memory hard rules honored: no new ledger record kinds, no new prepare/issue parameters, closed canonical payload, no third-party deps.
plan_sections.SI-01: Improvement artifact schemas and checker: blocker-observation/1 (one blocker instance in one run, enums reused verbatim from block-escalation, retry-budget-ledger, and audit-event schemas), blocker-pattern/1 (cluster with support counts, cost aggregate, generalizability verdict under burden-admission/1, engineering-memory recurrence entries), improvement-proposal/1 (decision vocabulary, required Complexity-admission triple, finding-shaped success_criteria with file/subject/required_paths/assertion, human-only ruling). Hand-written checker scripts/dev/check_improvement_artifacts.py validates committed artifact trees with stdlib only.
plan_sections.SI-02: Forensic miner: harness_labs/observability/run_forensics.py deterministically extracts blocker-observation records from local run journals, admitting only runs whose audit hash chain verifies via project_run_metrics. Reads events, decisions, checkpoint, summary, manifest, review-ledger, retry-budget-ledger, block-escalation, and workspace-change artifacts. Hard filter: only production_lifecycle evidence aggregates; fabricated_fixture parses but is excluded. Signatures normalized and secret-free; watermarked idempotent state under logs/improvement/state/.
plan_sections.SI-03: Pattern index: harness_labs/observability/improvement_index.py clusters observations by normalized signature plus classification with anti-N=1 thresholds (candidate at >=3 observations across >=2 lineages; proposable at >=2 distinct graph attempts or task suites; single-run findings stay observed forever). Computes support and median-plus-tail cost aggregates. Anti-thrash state: one open proposal per target-surface path, cooldown before re-proposal, hard cap on open proposals, rejected/regressed history bar.
plan_sections.SI-04: Improvement program: harness_labs/graphrun/improvement_program.py performs the engineering-memory joins (finding_history.fold_campaigns recurrence over prior campaign journals; decision_registry governing-decision annotation with refusal to draft against governed paths uncited; Inconsistency records surfaced, never resolved), drafts improvement-proposal/1 records via an injectable bounded judgment callable (refusing when the Complexity-admission triple or an executable assertion cannot be filled; gate_relaxation requires a ruling statement naming the gate and superseding mechanism), and assembles operator ruling packets. Rulings are never machine-authored.
plan_sections.SI-05: Convergence bridge and loop driver: harness_labs/graphrun/improvement_loop.py (campaign orchestration and close-out promotion) plus scripts/self_improve.py with subcommands audit, open, round, remeasure, status. open ingests an accepted proposal's success_criteria as the seed finding batch into a real ConvergenceLedger under logs/improvement/campaigns/. round synthesizes each PlanGraph from open_findings via plan_synthesis and dispatches only under an issued plan-approval receipt using campaign_launcher defaults. remeasure re-runs the miner plus each open key's assertion and folds convergence verdicts: only observed_fixed closes a key; unobserved blocks success termination; the round bound closes the campaign incomplete and reverts the pattern to candidate.
plan_sections.SI-06: Scheduling, close-out, CI, docs: repo-owned scheduled entry point (launchd template; CI cannot mine gitignored 0700-mode journals, so its job is running the SI-01 checker over the committed docs/improvement/ tree), close-out promotion of a successful campaign to a docs/decisions/ record with Concerns-paths filled from target_surface so the decision registry serves it in future approvals, docs/improvement/ committed home, agent guide plus INDEX registration, and .gitignore coverage for logs/improvement/.
plan_sections.SI-GUARDRAILS: Cross-cutting guardrails: read-only miner writing only under logs/improvement/ with capability-broker grants excluding docs, schemas, AGENTS.md, and code; implementation only inside receipted PlanGraph nodes; accuracy is a constraint never traded for efficiency; observations carry normalized signatures and hash refs, never raw transcripts; cold-start gold set backfilled from contract-burden-reduction items with proposal mode config-disabled until the corpus reaches roughly 20-30 production FeatureRuns across >=3 programs.

acceptance_criteria.AC-SI01-1: schemas/blocker-observation.schema.json, schemas/blocker-pattern.schema.json, and schemas/improvement-proposal.schema.json exist with protocol consts and additionalProperties false; a test asserts the classification and evidence_classification enums are equal to the enums loaded from schemas/block-escalation.json, schemas/retry-budget-ledger.json, and schemas/audit-event.schema.json rather than retyped copies drifting silently; and the resolution vocabulary, which has no external source, is defined exactly once in blocker-observation.schema.json's $defs and referenced from every use site, with a test tripwire failing if any enum in the three cited source schemas comes to overlap it substantially (>=50 percent) without being adopted as its source.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI01-2: scripts/dev/check_improvement_artifacts.py imports stdlib only, exits nonzero on a proposal missing any Complexity-admission field, on an accepted proposal without a human ruling (actor, statement, ruled_at), on a success criterion whose file is absent from its required_paths, and on a pattern with status addressed that does not name its campaign id and landing commit, and exits zero on a valid fixture artifact tree.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI01-3: every improvement-proposal success_criteria entry validates as intake-shaped (non-empty file, subject, required_paths, and an assertion with argv and timeout or a signature-absence check), so an accepted proposal can seed delta-to-run finding intake without transformation.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI01-4: tests/test_improvement_artifacts.py passes together with the full suite.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI02-1: run_forensics admits a run only when its audit hash chain verifies via project_run_metrics; a tampered fixture journal is excluded from output and reported as refused rather than silently skipped.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI02-2: on fixture journals the miner emits blocker-observation records for retry events, failed and blocked statuses, review-ledger findings with reopened_count greater than zero, and retry-budget abandoned or extended events, and every emitted signature is normalized: no absolute paths, run ids, or timestamps survive in the signature field.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI02-3: runs classified fabricated_fixture or otherwise non-production_lifecycle are parsed but excluded from every aggregate, and a test asserts the exclusion by counting.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI02-4: mining is watermarked and idempotent: a second run over an unchanged corpus emits no new observations, and adding one new run directory mines only that run.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI03-1: clustering groups by normalized signature plus classification; a pattern with fewer than 3 observations or fewer than 2 distinct lineages remains status observed, one meeting both thresholds becomes candidate, and proposable additionally requires at least 2 distinct graph attempts or task suites.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI03-2: each pattern record carries support counts and a median-plus-tail cost aggregate, and scripts/dev/check_import_boundaries.py stays green with both new observability modules importing only core, observability, and the standard library.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI03-3: anti-thrash state enforces one open proposal per target-surface path, a cooldown before a surface can be re-proposed, a hard cap on open proposals, and a bar on re-proposing a rejected pattern without new observations, each asserted by tests.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI04-1: patterns are annotated with prior ruled keys via finding_history.fold_campaigns path containment, each recurrence entry carrying campaign label, disposition, and operator statement, demonstrated against fixture campaign journals.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI04-2: target_surface entries are annotated with governing decisions from the decision registry; the drafter refuses to emit a proposal touching governed paths that does not cite the governing ADR, and registry Inconsistency records appear in the ruling packet unresolved.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI04-3: the drafter refuses to emit when the Complexity-admission triple or at least one executable success-criterion assertion cannot be filled, and acceptance validation rejects a gate_relaxation proposal whose ruling statement does not name the relaxed gate and the superseding mechanism.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI04-4: drafting judgment is an injectable callable so tests run with no live model, and ruling fields are validated as human-authored (non-empty actor and statement) before a proposal can reach status accepted.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI05-1: self_improve.py open refuses a proposal without an accept ruling, and for an accepted proposal creates a campaign root under logs/improvement/campaigns/ and ingests the success_criteria entries as the seed finding batch into a ConvergenceLedger whose key set equals the criteria's (file, subject) pairs.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI05-2: self_improve.py round synthesizes a decomposition from ConvergenceLedger.open_findings via plan_synthesis with one run per required_paths group, and dispatch refuses to launch without an issued plan-approval receipt for exactly that decomposition.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI05-3: remeasure folds convergence verdicts such that only observed_fixed closes a key, a key whose assertion did not execute folds unobserved and blocks success termination, and hitting the round bound closes the campaign incomplete and reverts its pattern to candidate.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI05-4: a fixture improvement campaign runs open, round with the stub driver, remeasure, and close end to end in tests with no live model and no real browser.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI06-1: the launchd template and self-improvement agent guide exist, the guide is registered in docs/development/INDEX.md, docs/improvement/ exists as the committed artifact home, and logs/improvement/ is gitignored.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI06-2: running scripts/dev/check_improvement_artifacts.py over the seeded docs/improvement/ tree exits zero, violations seeded into a copy exit nonzero, and tests/test_improvement_closeout.py exercises both, so CI validates committed improvement artifacts without needing journal access.
acceptance_criteria.AC-SI06-3: closing a successful fixture campaign emits a decision-record draft from docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md with Concerns-paths filled from the proposal's target_surface, and a test asserts decision_registry.active_decisions_for_paths returns the new record for those paths once accepted.

runs.objective: Define the three improvement artifact schemas (blocker-observation/1, blocker-pattern/1, improvement-proposal/1) reusing existing enums verbatim, plus a stdlib-only checker for committed artifact trees, so every later stage has a closed, falsifiable contract to emit against.

Build the deterministic forensic miner in observability: authenticated-journal-only extraction of blocker-observation records with normalized secret-free signatures, a hard production_lifecycle aggregation filter, and watermarked idempotent state under logs/improvement/state/.

Build the pattern index in observability: deterministic signature clustering into blocker-pattern records with anti-N=1 thresholds, support and cost aggregates, and anti-thrash state (per-surface uniqueness, cooldowns, caps, rejected-history bar) — no plangraph imports.

Build the graphrun-layer improvement program: engineering-memory joins (finding_history recurrence, decision-registry governance with refusal on uncited governed paths), bounded injectable proposal drafting that cannot emit an unfalsifiable proposal, and operator ruling packets with human-only ruling validation.

Build the convergence bridge and loop driver: harness_labs/graphrun/improvement_loop.py plus scripts/self_improve.py (audit|open|round|remeasure|status) turning an accepted proposal into a bounded convergence campaign over the harness repo — seed findings into a real ConvergenceLedger, per-round plan_synthesis and receipt-gated PlanGraph dispatch via campaign_launcher, re-measurement folding convergence verdicts, and bounded termination.

Wire recurrence and closure: repo-owned scheduled audit entry point with launchd template, docs/improvement/ committed artifact home, CI validation of committed artifacts via the checker, close-out promotion of successful campaigns into docs/decisions/ records the decision registry serves back, agent guide, INDEX registration, and gitignore coverage.
